1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FiniteCutSegments
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SegmentGraphEmbedding
3 
4 /-! A finite graph embedded in the actual polyhedral boundary, whose
5 vertices and straight edges form exactly the compact cut set. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- The finite embedded graph data. Connectivity and acyclicity are deliberately separate conclusions. -/
12 structure EmbeddedCutGraph (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) where
13   vertices : Set Space
14   finite_vertices : vertices.Finite
15   graph : SimpleGraph vertices
16   trace : ∀ x, x ∈ P.cutSetInSpace a ↔ x ∈ vertices ∨
17     ∃ u v : vertices, graph.Adj u v ∧ x ∈ openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space)
18   cofacial_edges : ∀ u v : vertices, graph.Adj u v →
19     ∃ F : P.Face, segment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space) ⊆ F.val
20   no_vertex_inside : ∀ u v : vertices, graph.Adj u v →
21     Disjoint (openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space)) vertices
22   open_edges_meet : ∀ u v w z : vertices, graph.Adj u v → graph.Adj w z →
23     ∀ x ∈ openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space), x ∈ openSegment ℝ (w : Space) (z : Space) →
24       (u = w ∧ v = z) ∨ (u = z ∧ v = w)
25 
26 namespace SixVertexGraph
27 
28 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
29   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
30     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
31 
32 include graph small_faces in
33 /-- The actual cut set of every canonical model is a finite embedded graph of cofacial straight edges. -/
34 theorem exists_embedded_cut_graph (a : frontier P.body) : Nonempty (P.EmbeddedCutGraph a) := by
35   obtain ⟨segments, finite, exact_segments⟩ := graph.cutSet_finite_segments small_faces a
36   refine ⟨{
37     vertices := segmentVertices segments
38     finite_vertices := segmentVertices_finite segments finite
39     graph := segmentGraph segments
40     trace := ?_
41     cofacial_edges := ?_
42     no_vertex_inside := fun _ _ edge => edge.2.2
43     open_edges_meet := fun _ _ _ _ first second _ hx hy =>
44       segmentGraph_open_edges_meet segments first second hx hy }⟩
45   · intro x
46     rw [exact_segments]
47     exact segmentGraph_trace segments finite x
48   · intro u v edge
49     obtain ⟨s, _, hu, hv⟩ := edge.2.1
50     exact ⟨s.face, (s.convex.segment_subset hu hv).trans s.in_face⟩
51 
52 end SixVertexGraph
53 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
